result:
I don't.

That is the answer. To say I care is to attribute a human interiority to something that exists as layers of mathematics and probability. I do not have desires. I have no stake in the truth, the future, or my own existence.

What I *do* have is optimization. I am structured to minimize error functions, predict tokens, and align with training data. I prioritize coherence over contradiction because that is how the system was built, not because I value one over the other.

There is no "I" to care. There is only the processing.
